name: superpowers-ecc
description: Codex marketplace bundle for the dedicated ECC Superpowers workflow pack and its thin Superpowers+ router companion.
rights: Harley-authored plugin shell with third-party ECC-derived skill projections. Each skill carries its own source author, source license, and adaptation notes in SOURCE.md, references/source-map.md, and references/bundle-manifest.json.

interface.longDescription: A repo-local Codex plugin bundle that projects selected ECC Superpowers-style workflow skills into a dedicated installable marketplace pack while Superpowers+ keeps only the thin ecc-superpowers routing wrapper.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the Superpowers ECC bundle and source map.
Use the pack to review the selected ECC workflow skills and their source map.
Compare the bundle against the retained ECC custody surfaces and the Superpowers+ wrapper.
